# AP DSC Exam Hall — Android app

Capacitor wrapper around the offline DSC Exam Hall web app (`www/`). Fonts, PDF libraries and all
textbook chapter data are bundled, so the app works without internet.

* `www/` is generated by `make_android.py` in the DSC Exam Hall build — don't edit it by hand.
* Every push to this branch runs `.github/workflows/build-apk.yml`, which builds a signed release
  APK and force-pushes it to the `android-apk` branch (also kept as a workflow artifact).
* `keystore/dsc-exam-hall.jks` signs the app so new versions install over old ones. Keep it; an APK
  signed with a different key cannot update an installed copy. For a Play Store release, move the
  keystore and its password to repository secrets.
